scope: Immediate predecessor links and explicit reasons for revisions of operator-reported search records; a different implementation question on the same day as round 1.
inclusion_criteria: Direct relevance to the assigned file-integrity or search-history decision
Primary practice studies and official technical specifications
Publication dates 2022-01-01 through 2026-10-20; foundational technical specifications retained separately
exclusion_criteria: Query-performance experiments without a direct archiving/history focus
Narrative guidance not needed alongside primary practice and normative provenance sources

searches.query: "search strategies"[Title] AND (version*[Title/Abstract] OR reproducib*[Title/Abstract]) AND systematic[Title/Abstract]
searches.query_translation: "search strategies"[Title] AND ("version*"[Title/Abstract] OR "reproducib*"[Title/Abstract]) AND "systematic"[Title/Abstract] AND 2022/01/01:2026/10/20[Date - Publication]
searches.limits: All returned records screened by title and complete abstract; no later result page existed. Truncated author/keyword fields not continued.
